lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance pixel clusters are organized in approximately vertical columns. Posterior to the gill slits, a column of at least five distinct nodes is visible, with subsequent columns to the posterior showing similar vertical alignment and regular inter-node spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the visible mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with lighter values on the dorsal aspect and shadow gradients on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal remoras) clustered near the pectoral fin and the ventral-lateral midline.
